title: Hey, Are You Here? (excerpt)
reference_type: Artist-published tempo and cross-aligned companion-mix-supported meter, pending independent aural review
reference_basis: A source-uploaded mix provides the timing anchor. Band-passed normalized cross-correlation aligns the dry stem to the mix at +10.757 s in 14 of 15 independently searched three-second windows (correlation 0.224–0.560). The mix has transient phases around 0.039–0.049 s at 123 BPM across low, mid and high frequency bands. Phase 0.024 s estimates the grid before acoustic decay/attack rise, and gives a verse-anchor agreement with the 22-beat dry stem start after accounting for the source alignment. Quarter phase carries about 30 ms model uncertainty. Four-beat grouping aligns with the eight-bar repeated opening phrase and distinct lift after two stanzas. Bar phase and lyric cue alignment await an independent human aural pass.
lyrics:
Are you here?
Can you see that life
Is happening around you?
Do you care?

When is the last time
You felt alive
You watched the sun
Set or rise?
